owner_decision.statement: The Owner directed completion of the remaining STYNX campaign work except DETRAN proofs. Stable 1.5.0 is published for all 44 fixed-group packages: authenticated registry census on 2026-09-29 observed latest 1.5.0 and rc 1.5.0-rc.2 on every package. The first postrelease changeset produced the historical 1.5.1 candidate. After origin/main introduced an approved session-policy HTTP patch and its pending changeset, the fixed-group generator computes 1.5.2 as the next complete candidate under the Owner's standing completion authorization. Publish only with the latest dist-tag and an action-specific exact-main-SHA Owner receipt; preflight latest must remain 1.5.0 and rc must remain 1.5.0-rc.2 until publication. This decision does not authorize angular-profile 2.0.0 remediation.

anomalies.rationale: The Owner adjudicated 2.0.0 as an incorrect major assignment rather than a canonical STYNX 2.x decision.
anomalies.closure_condition: Unified stable 1.5.2 is verified for all 44 publishable packages, latest resolves to 1.5.2, rc remains at 1.5.0-rc.2, and angular-profile 2.0.0 remains immutable non-canonical history.
